thread:
marie: Quick check — I'm flipping a TF var to switch projected token refresh to use VaultTokenBinding path for payment service. Will this cause service account tokens to be reissued simultaneously across all pods or just on restart?

aj: PR? :eyes:

marie: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/ops/merge/987 — change in modules/k8s/sa.tf, added annotation mapping and a toggle.

devin: Which annotation key did you use? We have a couple in prod. If it's the old `redwood.com/token-refresh` we might overlap.

marie: Using the new key: `redwood.com/projected-token-path`

marie: snippet:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: payment
  annotations:
    redwood.com/projected-token-path: "vault/data/payment/sa-token"
```

sam: FYI ExternalSecrets controller reads `externalsecret.redwood.com/` keys; projected token refresh is separate. Make sure the token-binding controller watches that annotation.

peggy: Can we add a migration window? If all pods reload at once we risk a short surge of auth calls. Suggest: add `rotation.stagger` label and default jitter 30s.

devin: Agree. Also add a fallback annotation so older clusters still get tokens via legacy path.

marie: good call — adding rotation.stagger label in TF and a fallback key. updated PR with a plan output in the description.

infra-bot: deploy-check: plan OK for staging, no tainted resources. (scan-id: c7b2)

aj: Can someone run `kubectl get pods -l app=payment -n prod -o wide` after the canary merge and ping me if any CrashLoopBackOffs? I'll hold the merge otherwise.

devin: Smoke-check command:
```
kubectl describe pod <pod> -n prod | egrep "Token|annotation|vault"
```

marie: I'll canary merge to staging now, watch for 15m then promote. Will post results.

marie: Staging canary looks clean — no 401 spikes, no restarts in 15m. Rolling promote in 10.

marie: Promote done. Watching for 1h.

peggy: :thumbsup: add an alert rule for token churn rate > 5/min to be safe.

marie: Filed alert PR. Thanks all.
